• Data Forwarding and Analysis: After aggregation, the sink node forwards the processed data to a central system, 
such as a cloud server, edge computing device, or control center. The central system performs in-depth analysis 
using machine learning (i.e. ML) algorithms, data analytics tools, or artificial intelligence to extract valuable insights. 
Based on the analysis, decisions can be made for automated responses, alerts, or further actions, such as adjusting 
environmental controls, triggering alarms, or sending notifications to users.
This coordinated process enables WSNs to function effectively in applications such as environmental monitoring, 
healthcare, smart cities, industrial automation, and precision agriculture. The seamless integration of sensing, processing, 
communication, and analysis ensures reliable data driven decision making across various domains.
